scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build-client -- --minify && npm run build-server -- --minify
scripts.build: npm run build-client -- --sourcemap && npm run build-server -- --sourcemap

configuration.title: Configuration for JSON Schema Language Server

jsonSchemaLanguageServer.defaultDialect.description: The default JSON Schema dialect to use if none is specified in the schema document

jsonSchemaLanguageServer.schemaFilePatte.description: The glob pattern for identifying JSON Schema files.

jsonSchemaLanguageServer.customVocabular.markdownDescription: npm packages, pinned to an exact version (for example `my-vocabulary@1.0.0`), that add support for custom keywords, vocabularies, and dialects. Packages are downloaded from esm.sh and run inside the language server. **You are asked to confirm before a package is loaded for the first time.** Only add packages you trust.
